CODE 
Art. 2.3.67. 
Evaluation of the original patrimony 
¤ 1. The original patrimony is valued as follows:
1¡ property existing on the effective date of the matrimonial property regime is valued on that date; 
2¡ property acquired after the effective date of the matrimonial property regime and which, by virtue of Article 2.3.66, ¤ 2, forms part of the original patrimony, is valued on the date of its acquisition.
However, real property and rights in rem in real property forming part of the original patrimony, other than usufruct, are valued on the date of dissolution of the regime. If these assets have been sold or replaced during the marriage, their value at the date of sale or replacement is retained. Changes in their condition undertaken during the marriage are not taken into account in the valuation of the original patrimony.
When the assets are valued at a date prior to the dissolution of the matrimonial property regime, their value determined in application of paragraphs 1 and 2 is indexed to the change in the general consumer price index.
Paragraphs 1 and 3 also apply to the valuation of debts.
